title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP
51 West 52nd Street
New York, NY 10019-6142
+1 212 506 5000
orrick.com
E. Joshua Rosenkranz
E jrosenkranz@orrick.com
D +1 212 506 5380
F +1 212 506 5151
July 17, 2025
Via Electronic Filing
Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
1 First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543
Re: Cox Communications, Inc., et al. v. Sony Music Entertainment, et al.,
No. 24-171
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent Petitioners in the above-captioned case.  Having conferred with
Respondents’ counsel, we write jointly to request that the Court enter the following
briefing schedule:
Petitioners’ brief:  August 29, 2025
Respondents’ brief:  October 15, 2025
Petitioners’ reply:  November 14, 2025
These extensions of time are requested to accommodate professional and personal
obligations during the briefing period, including in relation to Miniso Depot CA, Inc.
v. Yongtong Liu, No. 24-1215 (U.S.), Henderson v. United States, No. 25-13 (U.S.),
and Netlist v. Samsung Electronics Co., No. 25-01286 (Fed. Cir.).  Thank you for
your consideration.
Respectfully submitted,
/s/ E. Joshua Rosenkranz
E. Joshua Rosenkranz
Counsel for Petitioners
